n = int(input())

A = [0] * 21
B = [0] * 21

for i in range(1, 17):
    B[i] = B[i - 1] * 10 + 1
A[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 17):
    A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10

temp_num = n
digit_count = 0
while temp_num:
    digit_count += 1
    temp_num //= 10

min_cost = float('inf')

def recurse(position, current_value, total_cost):
    global min_cost
    if total_cost >= min_cost:
        return
    if position == 0:
        if current_value == 0:
            min_cost = total_cost
        return
    q = current_value // A[position]
    diff_neg = abs(q) - 1
    if q < 0:
        diff_neg = -diff_neg
    diff_pos = abs(q) + 1
    if q < 0:
        diff_pos = -diff_pos

    recurse(position - 1, current_value - q * B[position], total_cost + abs(q) * position)
    recurse(position - 1, current_value - diff_neg * B[position], total_cost + abs(diff_neg) * position)
    recurse(position - 1, current_value - diff_pos * B[position], total_cost + abs(diff_pos) * position)

recurse(digit_count, n, 0)
recurse(digit_count, B[digit_count + 1] - n, digit_count + 1)

print(min_cost)
